title: Carrying Capacity Dashboard: releases, data layers and results
description: A static rebuild of the Carrying Capacity Dashboard (Lane, Dawes and Grace 2014, 2015; Lane 2017): versioned releases of the model with 2011 and 2025 data and published, corrected and improved methods, the data pipeline, the browser evaluator and the results files. This is version 1.0.0, archived once the error search was finished and the corrected figures settled.
